finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache loss took prod down.** 17 minutes, start to finish.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | Cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:15:26–02:31:26 | 13 reconnect tries, all refused |
| 02:29:12 | Queue passes its cap at `depth 502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis never came back. Every read hit the store, 173 timeouts piled up, and the queue grew until `worker-2` ran out of heap.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused. Then cap the queue so a cache loss sheds load instead of eating memory.
